Feleen is a NPC from the Grand Quest: The End of An Empire. She is the Seventh Imperial Princess of Bariura Empire.

==History==

During the Great War, Feleen spends most of her time helping [[Selvia (character)|Selvia]], mainly to relay the news that Melina finds a space distortion that can be used to travel to [[Vilanciel|another world]]. At one point, Selvia orders her to deliver a heirloom to [[Berdette (character)|Berdette]].

===Brave Frontier Heroes===
The seventh imperial princess of the Bariura Empire. Whether due to her youth or for some other reason, she could hardly control her emotions, displaying intense expressions of joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure. Moreover, she often lacked consideration for those around her, showcasing a notably haughty demeanor. She did not hesitate to mercilessly punish those who did not obey her with her beloved whip, earning her fear from the subjects. While she rarely interacted proactively with her siblings, she was deeply devoted to the eldest imperial princess, Selvia, and served her with the loyalty and dedication of a trusted aide.
==Character==
Feleen is very obedient to Selvia's words. However, she tends to be impatient and a bit foul-mouthed to her other half-siblings.

==Relationships==
===[[Selvia (character)|Selvia]]===
Selvia saved Feleen's life during the latter's childhood. This is the reason why Feleen is very loyal to Selvia.

==Trivia==
*In the gold achievement's route, Feleen accompanies Selvia and [[Emperor of Bariura (character)|their father]] to another world, instead of Sirius.
*While not present as a unit in [[Brave Frontier]], Feleen is obtainable as a unit in Brave Frontier II.
**The same applies to [[Myuze (character)|Myuze]] and [[Selvia (character)|Selvia]].
